name: toml-cli
description: toml-cli — TOML file query and manipulation CLI. Read, write, and format TOML config files from command line.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/gnprice/toml-cli/releases/download/v0.2.1/toml-0.2.1-x86_64-linux.tar.gz && tar xzf toml-0.2.1-x86_64-linux.tar.gz && sudo mv toml /usr/local/bin/ && rm toml-0.2.1-x86_64-linux.tar.gz

commands.description: toml-cli — TOML file query and manipulation CLI. Read, write, and format TOML config files from command line.
